name: Mother Cinder
description: a vast will-o'-the-wisp, the burning village grown into one huge teardrop of fire the size of a house, white-yellow core and deep orange-red edges, a calm, heavy, motherly face painted inside the flame (two large half-closed black eyes and a small patient smile), soot-black smoke boiling off her crown, embers shaking loose from her underside

poses.loom: hanging in the air high above, flame tip flickering upward, looking down

idle.action: hangs and breathes, her flame swelling and settling slowly, a shower of embers shaking loose from beneath her, blinking her heavy eyes

note: Floor 998's background boss (the ember rain's source). Until it is generated the entity wears the Cinder's idle sheet, scaled up; priced in the PR, not approved (no GPU budget).
